# Repository guidance for GitHub Copilot

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. It is the canonical instruction set for safety, scope and native Windows validation. Use [docs/INDEX.md](../docs/INDEX.md) for the current code map, evidence, decisions and release process.

Do not implement historical .NET, HWND window-moving or speculative 4K/profile features from old branches or issue comments. Preserve native-display recovery invariants and run Windows CI on every code change.
